description.summary: private protocol between the tetra compositor and tetra-shell

protocol.description:
The compositor owns window management, including the task bar's slot model (which windows live in which of the 12 slots, pins, F-key activation); the shell only displays it and forwards clicks.
The global is offered only to the shell process the compositor started. Unstable: both sides are built from the same source tree.

entry.name: focused
entry.summary: a window in this slot has keyboard focus

entry.name: minimized
entry.summary: every window in this slot is minimized

event.name: slot

description.summary: state of one task bar slot

event.description: Sent for every slot when the shell binds, and for slots that change afterwards; a done event follows each batch.

arg.name: app_id
arg.summary: desktop ID (or app_id) of the slot's most recently used app; empty if free

arg.name: title
arg.summary: title of the slot's most recently used window

arg.name: windows
arg.summary: number of windows in the slot

description.summary: end of a batch of slot events
the user asked for the launcher (Super key tap)

request.name: activate_slot
request.description: Launches a pinned app with no windows, focuses the slot's most recent window, cycles through the slot's windows, or minimizes the only, already focused, window.

description.summary: start a new instance of the slot's app (Super+Shift+F)

event.name: media_key

description.summary: a volume or brightness key was pressed

event.description: The compositor keeps these keys from applications; the shell changes the volume or brightness and shows the on-screen display.

event.name: lock
event.description: Sent for Super+L, and when a session lock client died without unlocking (the session stays covered until a new lock client takes over; also sent to a shell that binds while that is the case). The shell answers by locking with ext-session-lock-v1.
